paper_title: Searching for Particle Dark Matter with eROSITA Early Data
notes: Paper sets DM decay rate limits (Fig 4) for mass 1.8-18 keV, converted to ALP g_agamma (Fig 7) and sterile neutrino mixing angle (Fig 6). The main eFEDS limit is the observed one; projections are also given. ALP coupling values read approximately from Fig 7 (10^-19 to 10^-17 GeV^-1 range). Exact numerical values not in tables; data points are rough estimates from the figure. C_agamma=0.75 (DFSZ) used for g_agamma conversion. ρ_⊙=0.4 GeV/cm^3 NFW profile.
